checks.name: remote API boundary and loopback-only architecture
checks.evidence: packages/server/src/index.ts:5-15 and packages/server/src/app.ts:122-317 show loopback host gating, 32-byte token enforcement, and 401 denial for non-loopback requests without a valid bearer token; packages/server/test/app.test.ts:9-30 covers the boundary.

checks.name: evidence record tamper detection
checks.evidence: scripts/security-team.mjs:85-89 freezes on receipt identity or scope mismatch, and scripts/security-team.mjs:90-92 blocks non-PASS or failed/untested checks.

checks.name: canonical three-agent roster integrity
checks.evidence: scripts/security-team.mjs:8-15 defines the fixed three-agent roster per team, and scripts/security-team.mjs:61 and 80 compare the manifest roster and scope hash against the canonical expectedAgents list.

checks.name: receipt contract validation
checks.evidence: scripts/security-team.mjs:23-32 enforces required fields, string identity fields, SHA-256 scope format, PASS/FAIL status, non-empty checks, and valid findings/limitations collections.

checks.name: blocking of failed or untested checks
checks.evidence: scripts/security-team.mjs:90-92 returns BLOCK when any receipt is not PASS or contains non-PASS checks; scripts/test/security-team.test.mjs:41-49 exercises the failed-check path.

limitations: Full node:test execution in this environment was not completed because mkdtemp hit EPERM on the system temp directory, so I relied on source inspection plus the available test output for verification.
